correctness.rationale: Exact entry-law conditioning and finite suffix sandwich; zero-truncated-Poisson lattice local limit gives uniform singleton hazard n^{-alpha}, while E[R_u]=O(1) over u=O(n^alpha) gives o(1) fresh repair. A telescoping product proves conditional Exp(1), and stationary renewal reward gives exact and asymptotic means. The included independently coded finite-state rational checker passes 98 checks; finite tests are not substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A polynomial persistence distribution for coverage episodes is a meaningful, nonroutine complement to exponentially rare first-entry events; the full conditional law cannot be deduced from the published stationary average, and a controlled repair-error analysis quantifies the new mechanism. Provides a natural benchmark for temporal occupancy clusters and expiring-resource systems without presuming downstream generality.
